title: Towards Trustworthy Foundation Models for Medical Image Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing studies that compare model performance metrics (e.g., Dice scores for segmentation, F1-scores for diagnosis) between male and female patient groups.
Analyzing research that correlates patient Body Mass Index (BMI) with model segmentation performance to identify disparities.
Examining literature that evaluates diagnostic accuracy and performance gaps across different racial groups (e.g., Asian, White, Black) in chest X-ray interpretation.
Discussing studies that assess model performance disparities between different age groups (e.g., 0-65 vs. 65+) in disease detection tasks.
Reviewing findings on disparate model performance in intersectional subgroups, such as Black female patients, compared to other groups and radiologists.
